documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto reported record performance for FY26, achieving record revenues exceeding INR 58,000 crores and record EBITDA crossing INR 12,000 crores. The company experienced strong growth across exports, domestic motorcycles, and electric vehicles, with Chetak crossing the 1 lakh retail mark in Q4. However, management noted a softening demand environment in April due to inflation and supply chain disruptions, and expects a near-term slowdown in the motorcycle category growth to 7% to 9%. To reward shareholders, the Board approved a final dividend of INR 150 per share and a buyback of INR 5,633 crores. Bajaj Auto reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q3 FY26, with revenue from operations crossing the INR 15,000 crores milestone for the first time.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to increase its monthly export volumes to over 220,000 units in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects the motorcycle category growth to slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in the motorcycle category to be driven almost entirely by the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments.
guidance.quote: But having said that, the great thing from our point of view is that we expect this growth to come almost entirely from the 125cc plus segment and even more so from the 150cc plus segment, which should grow at twice the industry rate.

guidance.claim: Management expects the growth momentum to continue in the first quarter of FY27.
guidance.quote: Keeping all the above in perspective, as also our actual April outcomes, we expect our growth tempo to actually continue in Q1 basis the strong competitive positions we enjoy in the key segments like the 150cc plus in domestic motorcycles, the EV business, both in 2-wheelers and 3-wheelers and the continued performance in large and stable territories like Latam and parts of Asia.

guidance.claim: The company expects the export business growth tempo to continue in the coming months.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months.

guidance.claim: The export business is on path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: The motorcycle industry is expected to continue to grow at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: The company expects three-wheeler growth rates to sustain in the immediate future.
guidance.quote: Again, we expect these growth rates to sustain in the immediate future as driver adoption is responding to the healthy improvements in earnings and paybacks, both for ICE and electric.

guidance.claim: The company expects to start scaling up Riki beginning in quarter 1.
guidance.quote: We expect to start to scale up Riki beginning quarter 1.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to inflation, price increases, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The upper half of the industry, particularly the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments, continues to drive growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Growth continues to be driven by the upper half of the industry with the 125cc plus segment growing faster than the 100cc segment and in particular the 150cc plus segment being the fastest growing.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and accelerated to over 60% growth in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The E-segment, scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and has continued to grow at an even higher rate of 60% plus in April, far outpacing the growth of ICE scooters.

demand_outlook.claim: The E-Rick segment has slowed down due to street regulation enforcement, leading to industry consolidation.
demand_outlook.quote: Though the E-Rick segment itself has slowed down due to enforcement of regulation on the streets, which is actually helping consolidate this industry in favour of the larger and better OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric 3-wheeler segment has seen very fast growth due to LPG shortages, CNG issues, and imminent petrol price hikes.
demand_outlook.quote: In the 3-wheeler segment, actually, the ICE segment has come down, but the electric segment has seen very, very fast growth because you see LPG shortage has been there, there is a CNG issue, there is a petrol price hike imminent.

demand_outlook.claim: The top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter, while Bajaj Auto's sales grew by 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Latam achieved its highest ever quarterly performance, driven by Colombia.
demand_outlook.quote: Latam delivered its highest ever quarterly performance powered by Colombia.

demand_outlook.claim: The motorcycle industry grew by about 15% in Q3 following the GST rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric segment continues to drive the three-wheeler industry by growing at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

demand_outlook.claim: KTM volumes were driven by strong demand in the Adventure portfolio, which grew nearly fourfold year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: KTM volumes were led by strong demand across the Adventure portfolio, which has grown almost 4x over the same period last year.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing capacity in Brazil has expanded to 60,000 units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has rolled out 80 joint KTM and Triumph showrooms.
capex_expansion.quote: The rollout of our joint KTM and Triumph showrooms has progressed swiftly with 80 such showrooms already operational.

capex_expansion.claim: Chetak's presence has expanded to over 850 cities.
capex_expansion.quote: The reach of Chetak today stands at 500-plus exclusive Chetak stores, combined with almost 3,000-plus motorcycle stores, which are shared with Chetak, and this presence has expanded to over 850 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capex was approximately INR 500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating options to expand Chetak's capacity in a quantum manner.
capex_expansion.quote: We are taking steps. There is some serious work going on to see how and where we should expand capacity in a quantum manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Brazil's sales came close to the 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came in close to 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities and the subsidiary is now delivering a healthy bottom line performance too.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its KT showrooms to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: The company strategically invested slightly over INR 2,300 crores in its Netherlands subsidiary during a nine-month period.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects a potential cost rise of 3% to 5% during the quarter, driven by the metal complex.
margins_costs.quote: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise during the quarter of about 3% to 5%, driven by the metal complex.

margins_costs.claim: The company is currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Key commodities like steel, copper, and aluminium have seen steep price increases.
margins_costs.quote: And to put that in some context, many of you would be aware from publicly disclosed numbers, steel is almost up 15%, copper 20%. Aluminium and Noble Metals, all up ranging from 35% to 45%.

margins_costs.claim: The electric portfolio achieved double-digit EBITDA margins in its entirety for the first time this year.
margins_costs.quote: Underpinning the margin delivery was a significant development that we have made on our electric portfolio, which hit double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the very first time in the course of this year.

margins_costs.claim: Chetak has reached EBITDA-neutral status as a portfolio.
margins_costs.quote: The improvements came on the back of rising scale of the very popular and profitable electric 3-wheelers and the improving unit economics of Chetak, which have now reached EBITDA-neutral as a portfolio.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached over INR 3,100 crores at a margin of 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at over INR3,100 crores at 20.8%, another all-time high and PAT crossed INR2,500 crores, yet another all-time high.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded sequentially by 30 basis points to 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: The company anticipated a commodity cost inflation impact of 50 to 60 basis points at the start of the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak's monthly manufacturing capacity has reached 50,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds a market share of close to 90% in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: The ICE franchise remains rock solid. The share in the CNG segment is close to 90%.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto maintained the number one position in electric 3-wheelers in Q4 and April.
orders_capacity.quote: We have maintained the number 1 position in electric 3-wheelers throughout Q4 and in April in terms of registrations.

orders_capacity.claim: The export business surpassed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto maintains a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment and over 85% in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's e-autos recorded their highest-ever levels in billing and retail during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our e-autos recorded their highest-ever levels during the quarter, both in billing and retail terms, and we exited the quarter in December back to the number 1 position in the segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The Pro-Biking business delivered combined volumes of over 35,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

orders_capacity.claim: Assets under management for BACL stood at nearly INR 16,500 crores at the end of December.
orders_capacity.quote: Assets under management stood at nearly INR16,500 crores as of December end.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the year with surplus funds exceeding INR 18,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto invested over INR 2,300 crores in BACL and BAIH BV.
capital_allocation.quote: We invested over INR2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV, the former to support the scaling of the lending book and the latter in furtherance of the KTM transaction.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto generated nearly INR 5,200 crores of free cash flow in the first nine months of the year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: The last capital infusion into BACL was about INR 300 crores in October.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties have impaired the company's ability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The war in the Middle East has imposed new challenges on the operating environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now we have to look forward in a changed scenario with some new challenges imposed by the war in the Middle East as the operating environment is experiencing significant change.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recorded an exceptional charge of INR 58 crores in Q3 due to employee benefit obligations under the Labor Code.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first was a charge of INR58 crores that we took in our quarter 3 numbers arising from the reassessment of employee benefit obligations given the revised definition of wages under the Labor Code.

risks_headwinds.claim: Reported PAT includes an exceptional gain of about INR 35 crores from prepayment of deferral incentives and loans.
risks_headwinds.quote: The reported PAT includes an exceptional gain of about INR35 crores arising on prepayment of deferral incentives and loans at the net present value.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals and other metals like aluminium and copper continued to harden.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company absorbed the withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives in the Electric 3-wheeler segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: These included - firstly, the absorption of the withdrawal of the PM E-DRIVE incentives in the Electric 3-wheeler segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company absorbed the full period impact of the GST rate increase on its 350cc plus motorcycles portfolio.
risks_headwinds.quote: Second, the full period impact of the GST rate increase on 350cc plus motorcycles portfolio was absorbed.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recognized a one-time exceptional charge of INR 61 crores due to changes in the definition of wages under the new labour code.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

management_commitments.claim: The team will focus on gaining share in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments through Q1 and the rest of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Through Q1 and rest of FY27, the team will remain absolutely focused on the areas which I've highlighted earlier, gaining share in the 125cc plus segment, particularly in the 150cc plus segment riding the continued industry growth.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to support KTM AG's management in its turnaround.
management_commitments.quote: KTM AG, we will continue to support the management there in the turnaround, which is well underway to bring back KTM in due course of time to its original performance.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto will continue to build capability and leverage scale in Bajaj Auto Credit.
management_commitments.quote: And finally, we will continue to build capability and now leverage scale in Bajaj Auto Credit to deliver an industry-class-leading performance.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to increase its monthly export volumes to over 220,000 units in the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its KT showrooms to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start scaling up Riki beginning in quarter 1.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start to scale up Riki beginning quarter 1.

management_commitments.claim: The export business is on path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company will fully consolidate the KTM business into its results on a line-by-line basis from the next quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: However, from the next quarter onwards, the KTM business will be fully consolidated into our results on a line-by-line basis as is required for subsidiaries.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team exercise for KTM Austria will be completed by April 1st.
management_commitments.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
